sentence: Not until the epistemological foundations were laid bare did the house of cards collapse
explanation: 'House of cards' significa una estructura frágil. 'Laid bare' significa expuesto. 'Not until' desencadena la inversión.

sentence: Were the academy to rest on its laurels the intellectual stagnation would be irreversible
hint: Formal conditional: Were + subject + to + base form
explanation: 'Rest on one's laurels' significa dormirse en los laureles, quedarse conforme. Condicional formal con 'were...to'.

sentence: The philosopher's magnum opus opened a Pandora's box of ontological questions that remain unresolved
explanation: 'Open a Pandora's box' significa desatar problemas imprevistos. Cláusula relativa con 'that'.

sentence: Only by reading between the lines can one discern the author's true ideological commitments
explanation: 'Read between the lines' significa entender el significado oculto. 'Only by' desencadena la inversión.

sentence: It is imperative that scholars not throw the baby out with the bathwater when revising established theories
hint: Subjunctive: It is imperative that + subject + base form
explanation: 'Throw the baby out with the bathwater' significa descartar lo bueno junto con lo malo. Modo subjuntivo.

sentence: Never before had a hermeneutic approach so thoroughly turned the tables on positivist methodology
explanation: 'Turn the tables' significa invertir una situación. 'Never before' desencadena la inversión con el pasado perfecto.

sentence: The dialectical tension between the two schools of thought proved to be a double-edged sword
explanation: 'Double-edged sword' significa algo que tiene tanto ventajas como desventajas. 'Proved to be' se usa para el resultado.

sentence: Under no circumstances should the academy sweep systemic inequities under the rug
explanation: 'Sweep under the rug' significa ocultar problemas. Una frase negativa desencadena la inversión.

sentence: Had the paradigm not been a sacred cow for so long the field would have evolved sooner
explanation: 'Sacred cow' significa algo exento de críticas. Condicional invertida para un pasado irreal.

sentence: Rarely does a single monograph succeed in killing two birds with one stone across disciplines
explanation: 'Kill two birds with one stone' significa lograr dos objetivos a la vez. 'Rarely' desencadena la inversión.

sentence: Such bureaucratic delays are par for the course in academic publishing
explanation: 'Par for the course' significa típico o esperado, dadas las circunstancias.

sentence: No one addressed the elephant in the room during the symposium
explanation: 'The elephant in the room' se refiere a un problema evidente que todos evitan discutir.

sentence: Critics argued the reform was little more than a Trojan horse for deregulation
explanation: 'A Trojan horse' se refiere a algo que parece inofensivo pero que oculta un propósito dañino.

sentence: The scandal continued to cast a long shadow over the institution's credibility
explanation: 'Cast a long shadow' significa tener un efecto negativo duradero sobre algo.

sentence: To gild the lily further would only weaken the argument's austere elegance
explanation: 'Gild the lily' significa añadir una decoración innecesaria a algo que ya es bueno, arruinando su efecto.

sentence: Overconfidence proved to be the committee's Achilles' heel
explanation: 'Achilles' heel' significa una debilidad fatal, de la Ilíada de Homero.

sentence: Only after the scandal broke was the outcome no longer a foregone conclusion
explanation: 'A foregone conclusion' significa un resultado inevitable o predecible. 'Only after' desencadena la inversión.

sentence: New archival evidence has helped shed light on the forgotten treaty
hint: Present perfect + helped + base form + idiom
explanation: 'Shed light on' significa ayudar a explicar o aclarar algo.

sentence: Faced with bankruptcy or a hostile merger the board confronted a Hobson's choice
hint: Past participle clause + subject + verb + idiom
explanation: 'A Hobson's choice' significa una elección aparente que en realidad no ofrece alternativa real.

sentence: Seldom does policy manage to strike a balance between competing interests
explanation: 'Strike a balance' significa encontrar un equilibrio satisfactorio entre dos extremos. 'Seldom' provoca inversión.
